import pytest
import helpers_g3_matrix as m
pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('no_lead')

def test_probe():
    rows = []
    seen = set()
    for fam in ['correction', 'partial', 'wrong', 'paraphrase']:
      for which in ('dev', 'holdout'):
        for cell, obs, want, d in m.run(which, families=(fam,)):
            left = m.blocking(d, want)
            if left or 'lookup_first' in d:
                key = (cell.state, cell.cloud, tuple(sorted(left)))
                if key in seen: continue
                seen.add(key)
                rows.append(fam[:4]+' %s/%s/%s %s adv=%s ans=%s cue=%s fail=%s und=%s | obs adv=%s fl=%s gens=%s lk=%s ctx=%s probe=%s cues=%s cls=%s' % (
                    cell.state, cell.cloud, cell.scene.name, dict(d), want.adv, want.answer, want.cue, want.failure, want.undecidable,
                    obs.adv, obs.failures, obs.gens, obs.lookups, obs.contexts, obs.probe, [c[:40] for c in obs.cues], obs.classes))
    assert False, 'PROBE %s\n' % fam + '\n'.join(rows[:40])
